interpretation: Normal Release execution with GGML_VULKAN_DEBUG=OFF. Separate DEBUG receipts establish the recorded dispatch controls.
Timings cover resident SCALE followed by MUL_MAT plus submission and synchronization. Allocation, upload, host reference work, and readback are outside the timed interval.

Each mode/case has one separately recorded first computation and 15 warm samples. Dense mode order alternates by case and is reversed in the second process; MMVQ auto/disable uses ABBA process ordering.
Dense mode arithmetic is qualified by its separate 597-graph native DEFAULT N1 fixture. Performance-mode finite/nonzero/repeat checks are not a cross-mode numerical-equivalence gate.
The mode-20 cost rises for larger N in this fixture. The measurements do not establish full-model throughput or expert-indexed projection latency.
Q4_K at N=8 had auto medians 63.05–63.54 us and disabled medians 77.14–77.38 us. Other cases showed noise or no advantage, so no general MMVQ acceleration claim follows.
No clock or power lock was applied. Full raw samples and IQRs remain available for inspecting variance.
